note: One of the first large-cap Delaware public benefit corporations to IPO; certificate includes an explicit public benefit purpose clause plus attached Series A Preferred Stock certificate of designations, useful positive example with additional capital-structure complexity. Also requires an unconditional 66⅔% supermajority vote to amend, repeal, or adopt any provision of the certificate — real, quotable language documenting a heightened-amendment threshold, though no rule in the current catalog (M1, M2, M3) tests amendment thresholds.
